rationale: The ES 8.8 aggregate Premier row lists Cloud Platform 10.2.x+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR. The task instead says Cloud Platform 10.2+, ES 8.7+, enabled assistant and paired SOAR. Existing triaged findings, first-ten and daily limits, models and connector/action/asset permissions remain scoped to their task. Both current 8.8 task paths describe CMP Cloud Connected Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0. The 8.7 task preserves older wording; the current 8.8 release page supplies November 4 GA, with the exact prior CA section unavailable. Edition and limited IL2 base-assistant evidence do not establish exact pairing, per-agent rollout, entitlement or customer authorization.

deployments: Premier Cloud and Cloud Connected CMP
exclusions: CMP has its separate Platform 10.4+/ES 8.8+/Cloud Connect 2.0 chain; no lower-floor eligibility, tenant rollout, entitlement, pairing or authorization is established.

remainingConcerns: Independently reconcile the missing mapped SOC Controlled Availability section, the native result for this exact attempt and production delivery evidence. Review by November 12.
